description: .NET: CI with dotnet format, warnings-as-errors build and dotnet test, SDK pinned by global.json
install: dotnet new globaljson --sdk-version <installed SDK from detect-workspace probes.dotnet> --roll-forward latestFeature
notes: Layout: the solution at the root, apps under src/<Name>, tests under tests/<Name>.Tests (a test project inside an app folder is compiled into the app). dotnet new sln writes .slnx.
